Aimé and Stinson,

Just got a copy of the attached report on healthcare innovation and thought it might be relevant for you.

On another note, I am organising a workshop this spring on Digital Transformation in Healthcare and will be inviting some Lumière Santé network colleagues for a 2-hour session on Friday 27 February. I’ll share more details as we finalise the agenda. The goal is to brainstorm about the new realities we face daily in patient care and hospital management, and what that means for our strategies. Hope you find this interesting and can join us.

Take care and enjoy your weekend.

Antoine
